cards.title: The Impact Player rule, introduced in IPL 2023, inflated IPL scoring.
cards.headline: IPL scoring rose from 8.31 to 9.50 runs per over; after netting out BBL, PSL and CPL over the same seasons the Impact Player era adds +0.66 (95% CI +0.37 to +0.96, p < 0.01) runs per over.
